scope: Independent fix for stale countdown admission; no playback/protobuf behavior change.
acceptance_criteria: Only an expiry emitted by the currently eligible countdown can prompt or disconnect.
Pre-start, generation-free, restarted, extended, reconfigured, canceled, and duplicate expiries are rejected.
Real expiries preserve existing prompt backoff and disconnect behavior.
Adapter tests deliver real timer packets instead of forged expiry events.

ownership.timer_worker: Session/watchdog expiry generation and deadline admission, internal packet fields, and package tests
ownership.coordinator: Adapter regression migration and integrated verification
ownership.independent_reviewer: Read-only timer code review, recorded in idle-expiry-review.json

risks: Replacement watchdog generations restart, so admission also checks the emitted deadline.
Extending a queued unconsumed expiry must invalidate the old packet without losing backoff state.
Existing callers forging expiry packets now need actual watchdog-issued events.

verification.note: Original isolated review reproduction now passes; permanent regression tests also cover this case.

rollback: Revert only this countdown-admission delta and associated tests, preserving the preexisting lifecycle, streamer, and protobuf work.
